outputs.explanation: The lower bar graph shows HMGB1 signal intensity as mean ± SD bars (N=4, n>100 cells) without overlaying the individual data points behind these averages.
The lower bar graph shows the percentage of aggregate-positive Purkinje cells as mean ± SD (N=4 mice per group) without showing the individual per-mouse data points.
This panel is a western blot image, not a quantitative plot of averaged data, so individual data points are not applicable.

This is a multi-group time-course line plot with mean ± SD error bars across many weekly time points; overlaying individual animal points for each of the four groups at each of the ~9 time points would be impractical and is not the expected convention for this plot type.

This is a multi-group line plot of rotarod performance across days at three ages, showing mean ± SD; as a time-course style plot with several groups, individual data point overlay is not the expected format.

This is a Kaplan-Meier survival curve, which is a step function directly reflecting each individual animal's event time rather than an averaged summary statistic, so overlaying individual points does not apply.
This panel consists of histological micrographs only, with no averaged quantitative data plotted.
Both bar graphs (molecular layer thickness and Purkinje cell number) show only mean ± SD across n=9 mice per group without displaying the individual per-mouse data points.
